Generic.welcome: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome aboard. Please fasten your seatbelts and ensure all carry-on items are stowed.
Generic.door_close: Cabin crew, arm doors and cross check.
Generic.safety_demo: Please pay attention to the safety demonstration. Exits are located...
Generic.climb_service: We will now begin our inflight service.
Generic.descent: We are beginning our descent. Please return to your seats.
Generic.arrival_prep: Please remain seated until the aircraft has come to a complete stop.

CCA.welcome: 女士们先生们，欢迎乘坐中国国际航空公司航班。请您系好安全带，收起小桌板。
CCA.door_close: 乘务组，舱门滑梯预位，交叉检查。
CCA.safety_demo: 现在播放安全演示，请注意观看。
CCA.climb_service: 我们将为您提供餐饮服务。
CCA.descent: 飞机即将下降，请回到座位坐好。
CCA.landing_prep: 客舱乘务员，请做好着陆准备。
CCA.arrival_prep: 感谢选乘国航航班，下次旅途再会。

UAL.welcome: Welcome aboard United. We're happy to have you with us today.
UAL.door_close: Flight attendants, doors to arrival and cross check.
UAL.safety_demo: Please give your attention to the safety video screens.
UAL.climb_service: Sit back, relax, and enjoy the flight.
UAL.descent: We are starting our initial descent.

welcome.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome aboard ANA. We are delighted to have you with us today.

door_close.text: Cabin attendants, arm doors and cross check.

safety_demo.text: We will now begin the ANA safety video. Please watch the screens carefully.

takeoff_prep.text: Cabin attendants, please prepare for departure.

climb_service.text: We will begin our inflight service shortly. Thank you for flying with ANA.

descent.text: We have started our descent. Please return to your seats and fasten your seatbelt.

turbulence.text: Ladies and gentlemen, due to expected turbulence, please return to your seats and fasten your seatbelts immediately.

landing_prep.text: Cabin attendants, please prepare for landing.

arrival_prep.text: Cabin attendants, please prepare the cabin for arrival.

deboarding.text: Thank you for flying with ANA today. Please remain seated until the aircraft has come to a complete stop.
